title: ZTIE synthesis-result (accuracy + gap_analysis) contract (v1)
description: The bounded, DERIVED, verdict-free synthesis result produced by the Story 3.3 Hub-side accuracy + gap_analysis synthesizer (RD-037) for one intake artifact — the false-positive-elimination + gap step of Phase 3 (Correlation & Synthesis). It reads the ONE verdict-free Nova Pro correlation result (Story 3.2, RD-035, 'correlation.contract.v1') already on the Hub tracking item and, in PURE deterministic logic (NOT a second model call — the semantic reasoning was already done in 3.2), (a) scores how well the correlation eliminates false positives (a static_only finding the dynamic behavior never exercised is a candidate false positive) and (b) surfaces where the two lanes disagree or leave a gap, recording the result back onto the SAME Hub tracking item. It is NOT a Forensic -> Hub crossing (its input already lives Hub-side); it is a Hub-INTERNAL derived field written by the 3.3 synthesizer Lambda, so it carries NO gate discriminator. It reasons ONLY over 3.2's bounded correlation result and references nothing raw (RD-009): no raw body, findings text, command log or raw trace. It records the synthesis HONESTLY — a 'status' (synthesized / no_correlation / skipped_no_findings) — so an absent or non-correlated upstream is never hidden behind a fabricated synthesis. It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious/clean field anywhere; the 'accuracy_score' is a descriptive reconciliation metric (NOT a safety score) and 'severity' roll-ups describe EVIDENCE, and the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded; every array maxItems-capped. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (SYNTHESIS_CONTRACT_VERSION).

contract_version.description: Synthesis-contract schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the 3.3 synthesizer (SYNTHESIS_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this record versions independently of the shared CONTRACT_VERSION and every crossing kind's pin.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this synthesis is for. The synthesizer writes it back onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body all lanes inspected. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the synthesizer only writes onto the tracking record whose sha256 matches the correlation it synthesized.

synthesized_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the synthesizer produced this result in the Hub. The only wall-clock field.

status.description: What the synthesis actually did, recorded HONESTLY (synthesized / no_correlation / skipped_no_findings). NOT a verdict — 'no_correlation' says there was nothing to synthesize, never that the artifact is safe/unsafe. When status != 'synthesized' the 'synthesis' object is omitted (no synthesis is fabricated).

status_detail.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable note about the status (e.g. 'upstream correlation status was model_error', 'correlation carried zero findings'). Never raw content, never a verdict.

correlation_status.description: The status of the upstream 3.2 correlation this synthesis was produced from (carried through for traceability). An UPSTREAM fact, never a verdict.

correlation_contract_version.description: Version of the correlation contract (3.2) this synthesis was produced from, for traceability.

source_finding_count.description: Number of correlation findings the synthesis reasoned over (from the upstream correlation). A bounded count, for traceability.

combined_complete.description: The combined event's aggregation-completeness fact (from 3.1, carried through 3.2) at the time of synthesis — whether all three inputs had landed. Used by gap_analysis to surface a 'coverage' gap when the correlation ran over incomplete inputs. An AGGREGATION-completeness fact, NEVER a verdict.

truncated.description: True iff the synthesizer capped a list (candidate_false_positives or gaps.items) to MAX_ITEMS (dropped the tail) or clipped an oversized field to fit the bounds. A completeness fact, never a verdict.

synthesis.description: The accuracy + gap_analysis synthesis of the 3.2 correlation: a bounded narrative summary, the accuracy block (candidate false positives + a descriptive accuracy score), and the gaps block (static<->dynamic disagreements + coverage gaps). EVIDENCE only — NO verdict anywhere. Present when status is 'synthesized'; omitted otherwise (the status records why).

summary.description: A bounded, deterministic narrative of the synthesis (how many confirmed correlations vs candidate false positives, and the notable gaps). Inert text; never a verdict, never raw content.

accuracy.description: The accuracy program's view: how well the 3.2 correlation eliminates false positives. It tallies the correlation findings by kind, surfaces the candidate false positives (static-only findings the dynamic behavior never exercised), and rolls them into a descriptive accuracy_score. EVIDENCE only — no verdict; the score describes reconciliation, not safety.

accuracy_score.description: A descriptive 0-100 EVIDENCE metric of how much of the flagged evidence the two lanes reconciled — the share of scored findings that are confirmed correlations rather than uncorroborated single-lane observations. HIGHER = more of the evidence is corroborated across both lanes (fewer candidate false positives). It is NOT a safety score and NOT a verdict — a high score does not mean 'safe' and a low score does not mean 'unsafe'; it only describes cross-lane reconciliation for the human gate + 3.4 to weigh.

confirmed_correlation_count.description: Number of correlation findings with kind 'correlated' (a static observation supported/explained by a dynamic one). A bounded count.

candidate_false_positive_count.description: Number of candidate false positives surfaced (static_only findings reconciled against benign dynamic evidence). A bounded count; equals the length of candidate_false_positives unless that list was capped (recorded via the top-level 'truncated' flag).

static_only_count.description: Number of correlation findings with kind 'static_only'. A bounded count (>= candidate_false_positive_count before capping).

dynamic_only_count.description: Number of correlation findings with kind 'dynamic_only' (dynamic behavior with no static explanation). A bounded count.

contradiction_count.description: Number of correlation findings with kind 'contradiction' (static and dynamic evidence disagree). A bounded count.

candidate_false_positives.description: The bounded list of candidate false positives (static-only findings reconciled against benign dynamic evidence). Capped at MAX_ITEMS; a correlation carrying more is truncated (recorded via the top-level 'truncated' flag), never overrun. EVIDENCE only.

items.description: One candidate false positive surfaced by the accuracy program: a static finding (a static_only correlation observation) that the dynamic evidence shows was never exercised, reconciled against benign dynamic behavior. Descriptive EVIDENCE for the Phase-4 human gate and the 3.4 scoring — a CANDIDATE for dismissal, never a decision that it IS benign. Bounded + allow-listed.

severity.description: Descriptive severity the correlation assigned the underlying static observation — how NOTABLE it is, NOT a decision. Carried through so 3.4 can weigh a dismissed high-severity flag differently from a low one.

title.description: Short, bounded title of the reconciled static observation (carried from the correlation finding). Inert text, never executed.

detail.description: Optional bounded note on WHY this is a candidate false positive (e.g. 'static-only finding with no correlated dynamic behavior'). Inert text; never raw content, never a verdict.

static_refs.description: Optional bounded list of short references to the static evidence this candidate draws on (carried from the correlation finding). Inert text references, never raw findings.

gaps.description: The gap_analysis program's view: where the two lanes disagree or leave a gap the human gate + 3.4 must weigh. A bounded list of gaps + a rolled-up worst severity + a count. EVIDENCE only — no verdict.

gap_count.description: Number of gaps carried (<= MAX_ITEMS). A bounded count.

highest_gap_severity.description: The worst descriptive severity across the gaps, rolled up for convenient downstream (3.4) query. Descriptive EVIDENCE, NOT a decision. Omitted when there are no gaps.

items.description: The bounded list of gaps. Capped at MAX_ITEMS; more are truncated (recorded via the top-level 'truncated' flag), never overrun. EVIDENCE only.

One gap surfaced by the gap_analysis program: where the static and dynamic lanes disagree (contradiction), where a lane's evidence is unexplained by the other (static_uncorroborated / dynamic_unexplained), or where the correlation was produced over incomplete inputs (coverage). Descriptive EVIDENCE for the Phase-4 human gate and the 3.4 scoring — never a verdict. Bounded + allow-listed.

gap_type.description: The kind of gap (static_uncorroborated / dynamic_unexplained / contradiction / coverage). Descriptive, never a verdict.

severity.description: Descriptive severity roll-up for this gap — how NOTABLE it is, NOT a decision. 'unknown' when the underlying evidence was not rated.

title.description: Short, bounded, human-readable title of the gap (carried/derived from the correlation finding). Inert text, never executed.

detail.description: Optional longer, bounded explanation of the gap. Inert text; never raw content, never a verdict.

static_refs.description: Optional bounded list of short references to the static evidence this gap draws on (carried from the correlation finding). Inert text references, never raw findings.

behavioral_refs.description: Optional bounded list of short references to the dynamic behavioral evidence this gap draws on (carried from the correlation finding). Inert text references, never the raw trace.
